# ZAYVORA Health OS™ — Master Test Plan & QA Strategy

## Testing Levels & Coverage Targets
1. **Unit Testing (Target: >90% coverage):** Deterministic algorithms, Mizaj calculation, posology formulas, cryptographic hashing.
2. **Integration Testing:** Microservice inter-communication, PostgreSQL transactional integrity, ABDM mTLS gateway handshakes.
3. **Safety & Gating Verification:** Explicit penetration testing of prescribing barriers, Schedule E(1) Mudabbar blocks, and allergy holds.
4. **End-to-End Continuum Verification:** 30 critical workflows executed against live service instances.
5. **AI Robustness & Safety Red-Teaming:** Prompt injection defense, biomedical emergency red flag detection, hallucination rejection.
